policy_mode_unavailable: This screen is not available while you edit the CI policy.
policy_mode_unavailable_fix: The open folder is a policy, not a project. To validate a project, open the interface inside it with jgates ui.
policy_governed_locked: The CI of this project is governed by the policy {policy}: the project configuration cannot be changed here.
policy_governed_locked_fix: Change the policy in the policy repository (jgates ui --policy <folder>). Without JGATES_POLICY_DIR in the environment, the project configuration is editable.
policy_mode_required: This action only exists when the interface edits a CI policy.
policy_mode_required_fix: Open the interface with jgates ui --policy <policy folder>.
policy_project_not_absolute: The project path must be absolute.
policy_project_not_absolute_fix: Give the full path of the project folder, for example /home/ana/projects/api.
policy_project_not_found: The project folder does not exist: {path}
policy_project_not_found_fix: Check the path and try again.
policy_err_policy_dir_missing: The policy folder does not exist: {path}
policy_err_policy_dir_missing_fix: Pass --policy with a folder that exists.
policy_err_policy_root_missing: The policy folder has no jgates.yml.
policy_err_policy_root_missing_fix: Create the configuration in the folder with jgates init --cwd <policy folder> and open the interface again.
policy_err_policy_inside_project: The policy is inside the analyzed project: {path}
policy_err_policy_inside_project_fix: Keep the policy in a separate repository, outside the project folder.
policy_err_policy_symlink: The policy has a symbolic link: {path}
policy_err_policy_symlink_fix: Replace the link with the real file; a link would give different bytes on different systems.
policy_err_policy_ref_outside: The policy configuration uses a file outside its folder: {path}
policy_err_policy_ref_outside_fix: Move the file into the policy folder and point to it with a relative path.
policy_err_policy_bad_path: A policy file has a line break in its name: {path}
policy_err_policy_unreadable: The policy file could not be read: {path}
